title: [FEATURE] Make Groups FERPA compliant
body:
**Re: University Monday 2022/03/21** / 2022/03/23

1.2.1.3 Groups to be FERPA compliant. 

1.2.1.3.1 In settings/privacy center at the bottom above Privacy Statement add a Checkbox default to false for "FERPA compliant". Store in Core BB user profile?

1.2.1.3.2 May need Mladen. In Groups only show a user's Name to Admins if this user has FERPA True. So for regular members anywhere they can see a member's name it must be hidden. For now just show "Suppressed" as the name.


**Update**: FIRMA replaced with FERPA
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: @dobromirdobrev   Good morning, I believe you mean FERPA (Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act)?
